data.description: The churning winds of a mihstu's body automatically deflect nonmagical projectiles (such as arrows, bolts, and sling stones).  All other ranged weapons (including magical projectiles and thrown weapons) have a 20%% miss chance.  Weapons of significant size, such as giant-thrown boulders, siege engine projectiles, and other massive ranged weapons are not affected by this ability.
data.name: Wind Defense
